pack.proposed_change: Test a volatility-regime filter that blocks entries when the 30-minute ATR percentile is below 20% or above 90% of its trailing 60-day distribution. Evaluate it on sealed holdouts with existing spread and slippage assumptions, against the current validated-state baseline. Accept only if net expectancy improves and maximum drawdown does not worsen; otherwise reject and record the result.
